name: Equity REIT ETF (Real Estate Income)

yield.notes: VNQ, SCHH type funds. REITs must distribute 90%+ of taxable income.

flags: REIT dividends mostly ordinary income (less tax-efficient)
Rate-sensitive: REITs tend to fall when interest rates rise
Exposure to commercial real estate trends (office, retail, residential)

startup_checklist: Choose: VNQ (broad), SCHH (low-cost), O (monthly-paying single REIT) or diversified ETF
Allocate 5-15% of portfolio as real estate exposure
Track annual distributions and tax character (some return-of-capital, which is tax-deferred)
failure_modes: Commercial real estate downturn reduces REIT distributions
kill_criteria: Yield drops below 2.5% for 2 consecutive quarters
Significant exposure to distressed commercial real estate sector
sources_note: Yield data from ETF provider distributions.
